title: Environment placement
description: Schema for <env>/placement.yaml — adopter facts about node placement. `placement` maps the template's placement groups (pg-N) to physical provider nodes. `pools` overrides template node pools BY NAME (merge semantics: maps deep-merge; an override changing count inherits everything else; enabled: false drops a default pool — greppable, a visible decision rather than an absence; unknown names add extra pools).

placement.description: Placement group -> physical node name (e.g. pg-1: pve-node-a). Every pg-N the selected template references must be mapped; the plan fails otherwise.

pools.description: Per-pool overrides merged by name onto the template's node_groups: partial keys (count, cores, memory, disks, placement, tags, class) plus enabled: false to remove a pool. New names define extra pools and must then carry the full pool shape.
